sourceFile: 22-1. BRS-201506 Report checking NTI test coil wire RCW KTP 18-0.093mm date 1.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable Normal/Test 1 acoustic comparisons but the changed factor and outcome grouping are not verified.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not an evidenced condition.
Baseline and test meanings are ambiguous beyond sample labels.
Outcomes contain raw auto-stats, masks, frequencies, and errors as results.
Standard/Normal/Test 1 roles are not consistently separated.
Several cited rows are not shown in review context.
requiredUserQuestions: What physical condition does Normal represent?
What physical change does Test 1 represent?
Is Standard a reference only or part of the comparison?
correctionPlan: Replace filename changed factor with the confirmed condition contrast.
Define baseline/test roles using sample-name rows and report title context.
Regroup outcomes as SPL, F0, THD, and IMP under one validation context.
Remove #DIV/0, mask, frequency-axis, and per-column auto-stat artifacts.
Use concise citations to GRAPH summary rows and RAW DATA headers/sample-name rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations prove labels and metrics exist but are insufficient for final changed-factor evidence.
